description: Use when enabling shadows in a Three.js scene or debugging shadow artifacts like acne, peter panning, or low resolution. Prevents the common mistake of wrong shadow camera frustum, too many PointLight shadows, or missing castShadow/receiveShadow flags. Covers shadow map types, per-light config, bias tuning, CameraHelper debugging.
